ink.$description: Ink — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

canvas.$description: Canvas — Dominant page background for a soft, inviting base layer

snow.$description: Snow — Component backgrounds, button fills, and secondary surface layers

sandstone.$description: Sandstone — Subtle background for cards and secondary page sections, providing gentle visual separation

tangerine.$description: Tangerine — Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

times.$description: Fallback and decorative usage, often for short, impactful statements or where a classic serif feel is desired.

supreme-ll-tt.$description: Primary brand typeface for all body text, headings, and interactive elements. Its subtle tracking adds a distinctive, composed feel.
